title: Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the parts of a friendly invitation letter and its message: the event, the date, the time and the place.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of a friendly letter.
floor.question: Barua ya kirafiki huanza na?

contexts: healthy eating: a party with healthy food

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the parts and the event details.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa nini?" Kwa nini "jina la mwandishi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua huanza kwa anwani na tarehe, huisha kwa hitimisho na jina.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni salamu ipi inafaa barua ya kirafiki?" Kwa nini "Mkuu wa Shule" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa salamu ya kirafiki.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mwaliko huandikwa kwa nini?" Kwa nini "kumkaripia mtu" si jibu sahihi?
Rafiki atajua aje lini na wapi?
misconceptions.repair: Mwaliko hutaja tukio, tarehe, saa na mahali.

checks.question: Taja mambo manne ya tukio katika mwaliko.

skills.key_step: The child plans barua ya kirafiki before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: mwaliko wa sherehe ya lishe bora
a letter or story for a family member

board.do: Mwaliko wa Sherehe ya Lishe Bora

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Mwaliko wa Sherehe ya Lishe Bora".

misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.

misconceptions.ask: Rafiki yako anakuita kwa jina gani?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika barua ya kirafiki kuhusu "Mwaliko wa Sherehe ya Lishe Bora"?
Barua ya kirafiki ina sehemu zipi?
